legend.0: No reliable single cell identity is supported: the markers are insufficient, nonspecific, or strongly conflicting across distinct cell identities.
legend.1: Weak coherence: substantial conflicting or mixed cell-type evidence prevents a clear single-cell identity.
legend.2: Ambiguous: one or more plausible cell identities are supported, with meaningful conflicting or mixed evidence.
legend.3: Mostly coherent: one cell identity is clearly favored, with only minor conflicting or nonspecific evidence.
legend.4: Highly coherent: the markers strongly and consistently support one clear cell identity.
